items.summary: Secure your OpenClaw with one click. Audit, harden, and fix — no expertise needed. Plain-language reports surface hidden risks. Built-in rules block misuse automatically. Clear guides tell non-technical users exactly what to do.

latestVersion.changelog:
**Aegis4All v4.0.1 Changelog**

Expanded the audit layer from 12 to 20 checkpoints, adding DM pairing policy, group allowlists, node pairing, browser control, control-plane tool lockdown, network exposure, dangerous flags, and CVE version checks.
Integrated the official openclaw security audit command: overlapping checkpoints now read authoritative results first, with paper-defined detection rules as fallback.
Published the scoring formula: Critical / High / Warn weighted 7 / 4 / 3, warnings deducted at half weight, Score = 100 − deductions.
Redesigned the report into a single-message 4-column table (Checkpoint / Status / Detail) driven by deterministic per-checkpoint decision rules.
Added the Fix Follow-up repair loop: natural-language fix offer, explicit user confirmation before any change, then re-run safe check and report the score delta.
Added a 20-row Defense Mapping with fix safety ratings (EXECUTABLE / CONDITIONAL / ADVISORY / REFUSED) and four safety rules for automatic fixes — never restart the Gateway, never self-lock out, fix all applies only to EXECUTABLE and CONDITIONAL items.
Added Guide 6 (Lock down DM and group access) plus a compact Guide Index and Full Guide Reference.
